items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah I think Lee Konitz — I did some recording with him. But the rest of them, well they weren’t recording dates. I was just playing with them, like Gerry Mulligan and Lee Konitz...

ctx.x: Generally in there: ’58, ’57, maybe ’56 before I left Philadelphia.
